fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential network activity of Site24x7 RMM tool
fields.name: Potential Site24x7 RMM Tool Network Activity
fields.query: (event.category in ("dns","url","ip")) and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((url.address="*plus*.site24x7.com" or url.address="*plus*.site24x7.eu" or url.address="*plus*.site24x7.in" or url.address="*plus*.site24x7.cn" or url.address="*plus*.site24x7.net.au" or url.address contains "site24x7.com/msp") or (event.dns.request="*plus*.site24x7.com" or event.dns.request="*plus*.site24x7.eu" or event.dns.request="*plus*.site24x7.in" or event.dns.request="*plus*.site24x7.cn" or event.dns.request="*plus*.site24x7.net.au" or event.dns.request contains "site24x7.com/msp")))
